before.rule: For each actual whole packaging article, P records paid procurement (standalone or bundled, with or without a separate invoice). I records first non-purchased external ingress, including standalone gifts, loans, rental/pool issues and unpaid supplier-attached packaging; supplier attachment is only one I subset. ER requires the same item or an auditable matching batch linked to this site's own prior outward record; another party's prior use alone is not a return. P/I/ER are disjoint. The existing matching physical-article cards and raw subledgers cover these origins subject to every native material/form/state qualification; incompatible actual articles require their own atomic rows, never a substitute UUID. X_in/X_out remain separate measured material/water-change terms, not a substitute for whole-article receipt. Keep gross wet quantities, owner/custodian, payment/non-purchase basis, provenance, prior-outward links, actual state/unit and inherited manufacture/service vectors. A free receipt is neither a new manufacture nor automatically burden-free: attribute actual service and incremental transport/handling once to the proper original cohort/denominator and retain genuinely unused service separately, without a default lifetime or credit. Stock, physical gross legs and burden vectors remain separate. This is the declared conserving foreground-accounting implementation, not a claim that the cited source prescribes these variable names.

scalars.text: This ledger spans receipt and actual attachment before or after quality release; each actual packaging operation is assigned once to its recorded manufacturing/cohort-service gate. For each packaging material separately: opening empty + attached WIP/FG + reusable stock + P + I + ER + F_in = closing empty + attached WIP/FG + reusable stock + S + EO + W + F_out, in consistent measured mass/state. P is paid standalone or bundled, I first non-purchased external ingress, ER external return received, S packaging on gross physical dispatch, EO external return sent, W waste. F_in/F_out are independently measured material/water additions/removals across this article pool, disjoint from contents already inside the corresponding whole-article legs. Trace each origin/destination and its component/whole-article bridge; internal pool/repair transfers pair and cancel once at consolidation, without creating another purchase/provider. X_in/X_out remove only documented overlap with another already-counted SAME-SIDE gross inlet/outlet term; a closing stock is never such an overlap term. Internal reuse cancels; preserve all six whole-article legs and their separate empty/attached/reusable wet stocks. Preserve actual new influx and full closing wet mass together. Do not put packaging in Q or buy reused assets again; upstream owner once, no automatic coproduct or credit.

Keep physical equipment/tooling inventory separate from attributable current service burden. Preserve opening/closing installed mass, each actual new/old repair part, lubricants and water with their real X_in/X_out. X terms deduplicate only other gross incoming/outgoing terms, never remove an influx because its material remains installed. No fixed service life, universal wear rate or whole machine per m2. Collect actual offsite freight and outsourced operations as separately identified service atoms with gross load/distance/mode and provider boundaries; supplier-included service is owned once.

## 9. Validation Rules

| rule_id | applies_to | rule | source_ids |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| v_identity | all inventory rows | Verify whole terminal/material identity, actual Product/Waste/Elementary type, CAS, phase/form, route, geography, compartment and every native property limitation; use exact property-to-unit-group reference units. Selected generic native family does not prove supplier/background applicability. Leave incompatible or unresolved atoms unbound and track them. | `arma-residential-manual-2014`; `tarco-fiberglass-msr` |
| v_basis | finished_roll | Require all declared qualifiers, complete first-release QC, single projected material area and matching configuration. A rectangle alone permits length times width; arbitrary/irregular geometry needs traceable design-specific measurement. Roof coverage, overlaps, both faces, nominal roll weight and secondary density coefficients cannot define Q. | `arma-residential-manual-2014`; `tarco-fiberglass-msr` |
| v_accounting | all inventory rows | Require raw original-unit data, unit/rate conversion, justified allocation and inherited vectors before a single A/Q normalization. Collection protocols retain raw records; cards and aggregation reuse that one result. Q=0 retains actual burden but has no unit result. Never divide a previously normalized value again. | `ilcd-detailed-2010` |
| v_complete | all inventory rows | Reconcile manufacturing, FG/service, combined physical and element gates independently; packaging six legs and repairs/water X do not erase inflows retained in stock. Check failures, start/stop, idle, cleanup, unreleased WIP/rework, FG returns, assets and all real added atoms. Unknown is not pass, zero or not_applicable. | `ilcd-detailed-2010` |
| v_service | service | Require original cohort Q, actual observation horizon, gross dispatch/returns and retained performed-service burden. Post-release rework requires permission and posttests/acceptance/disposition, with real incremental materials/water/energy/waste; never assume damaged product restored or a new output. | `arma-residential-manual-2014`; `ilcd-detailed-2010` |
| v_sources | all inventory rows | Do not use industrial process documents as allocation evidence or apply literature recipe, temperatures, line speeds, densities, lifetimes or ratings as defaults. Identify source scope and limits, actual foreground uncertainty and missing evidence; a declaration or mechanical check is not site observation or scientific approval. | `arma-residential-manual-2014`; `tarco-fiberglass-msr`; `ilcd-detailed-2010` |
